name: ai-web-reading-benchmark
description: Experimental benchmark measuring how well different AIs read and extract information from a web page.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w backend && npm run test:unit -w frontend
scripts.test:security: npm run test:security -w backend && npm run test:security -w frontend
scripts.test:smoke: npm run test:smoke -w backend && npm run test:smoke -w frontend
scripts.coverage: npm run coverage -w backend && npm run coverage -w frontend
